headline: Sensex and Nifty end flat on expiry day as strong Q2 earnings from UBL and Piramal Pharma offset IT drag

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Market volatility was driven by the monthly expiry day and a choppy trading session
Elevated crude oil prices and jitters regarding US Federal Reserve policy weighed on sentiment
Significant selling pressure in the IT sector dragged down the benchmark indices
Strong performance in the pharma and realty sectors helped offset broader market losses
whatHappening: United Breweries reported a tripling of net profit to Rs 135 crore for the second quarter
Tata Motors partnered with Amazon to deploy 3,000 electric trucks for delivery operations
Piramal Pharma successfully swung to a profit in Q2, while SAIL revenue grew by 22%
Bharti Airtel and Power Grid shares rose by 3% each despite the flat market closing
summary: The Indian stock market ended flat on a volatile expiry day as gains in pharma and realty balanced a drag in IT stocks. United Breweries and Piramal Pharma reported strong Q2 earnings, while Tata Motors announced a major EV partnership with Amazon. Investors remained cautious due to elevated crude oil prices and global cues from the US Federal Reserve.
